intent: Review and fix English-default, English/Simplified Chinese interface switching before mainline delivery.
execution: Serial self-review in the main thread, following the user's AGENTS.md; no independent review agents.

findings.title: Keep English footer shortcuts within narrow windows
findings.why_it_matters: Longer English button labels overlapped the keyboard shortcuts at 960x600.
evidence: The initial English screenshot showed the overlap.
Final QML probes verify separation, text width and bottom bounds in both languages and both dimensions.
findings.suggested_fix: Use two shortcut lines in narrow windows and reserve their available width.

findings.title: Render terminal startup errors and retain component error translations
findings.why_it_matters: Startup exceptions reached the popup as Chinese source strings. QML component failures were translated too early to update an already open error after a language change.
evidence: Subprocess tests check a nonexistent program in both saved languages.
The native component failure stays marked until snapshot rendering; a regression changes its open error between English and Chinese.
findings.suggested_fix: Render at the startup output boundary and originate component failures as deferred controller messages.

findings.title: Preserve deferred network security labels
findings.why_it_matters: Formatting the security label into an f-string flattened its translation marker, leaving Chinese text in English network rows.
evidence: Regression tests check Open network and 开放网络 across an open adapter menu.
The same test verifies literal SSIDs and unchanged network identifiers.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass security and strength as deferred message parameters.

findings.title: Detach state published through Python object signals
findings.why_it_matters: Object signals retain translation markers but can also share mutable service objects across queued worker/UI delivery.
evidence: A worker-thread regression publishes a state and immediately clears the original device list.
The queued UI snapshot retains the device and can translate its error into either language.
findings.suggested_fix: Deep-copy the published payload while preserving Message metadata.

findings.title: Render shell and terminal argument-parser messages
findings.why_it_matters: Passing a deferred str subclass directly to argparse printed the Chinese source even when English was selected.
evidence: The English command-line regression failed before rendering was added.
Four subprocess cases now check help and invalid smoke-test arguments for both applications in both languages.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve saved language before parsing and render authored help/errors at that output boundary.

verification.native_pty_language_switch: passed on uConsole without recreating session objects or processes
verification.live_language_menu: English to Simplified Chinese to English, using virtual keys
verification.language_persistence: Chinese preference retained across shell restart

residual_risks: The existing Terminal 0.1.0 process is deliberately preserved; its next normal launch loads 0.1.1 and language synchronization.
testing_gaps: Virtual keyboard and offscreen QML checks do not establish physical ABXY or USB unplug acceptance; those remain onsite checks.
